Distribution (Fig. 17). Only known from the type locality, Villa Nizao, Barahona province, at the foothills of eastern extreme of Sierra de Bahoruco, Dominican Republic. Apparently the species also inhabits several localities around the type locality, all at Barahona province (see Discussion). Natural history. Unknown. The type series was collected only at the type locality, a secondary mesic forest mixed with coffee plantations.
Distribution. Known only from the type locality in Panama.

Distribution in Iran. East Azarbaijan: North of Tabriz, 38 km South of Marzan (Kazantsev 1992). Generic records: Iran (Kazantsev 2004; 2011; Kazantsev & Brancucci 2007). Distribution outside Iran. Armenia, Azerbaijan (Kazantsev & Brancucci 2007; Kazantsev 2011). Remarks. Kazantsev’s (1992) record “ NW of Ordubod Nakich ” is to be referred to Azerbaijan.
DISTRIBUTION IN BRAZIL. — SE (Cáceres et al. 2014); PB (Menezes et al. 2018).
Distribution in the Arabian Peninsula: United Arab Emirates (Straka & Schmid-Egger 2017). Extralimital distribution: No records.

Distribution: — To date, Mallomonas arenosa has been observed in two closely located water bodies in Thua Thien-Hue Province, Phong Dien District, Viet Nam. In addition to the type locality, it has been found in another unnamed water body of a similar type (Latitude / Longitude: N 16 ° 38.576 ′ E 107 ° 22.515 ′).
Distribution: Kashmir, NW Himalayas, Uttarakhand, Meghalaya, Sikkim (Khasi Hills, Shillong, Cherrapunji) (Obraztsov 1957, Singh et al. 2014), Tripura (Sondhi et al. 2021).
